description: Extract a subset of pages from a loaded PDF into a new PDF file on disk. Carries all takeoff shapes and annotations on those pages into the new document (mapped to pages 1..N). Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

overwrite.description: Replace the file at path even when it is not an OpenTakeoff export. Off by default: re-exporting over a previous export of your own already overwrites without this, so you only need it to deliberately destroy an unrelated file.

name: extract_pages
